create_task_state: create a TaskState model to track task lifecycle with UUID7 ordering and denormalized project_id
create_annotation_state: create an AnnotationState model to track annotation state with denormalized task, project, and completed_by fields
create_project_state: create a ProjectState model to track project lifecycle with denormalized created_by_id field
get_current_state: get the current state of an entity using UUID7 natural ordering without created_at indexes
get_state_history: get the complete state history for an entity ordered by most recent UUID7 first
get_states_in_range: get all states for an entity within a time range using UUID7 embedded timestamps
get_states_since: get all states for an entity since a specific timestamp using UUID7 filtering
get_denormalized_fields: get denormalized fields to store with each state transition for performance optimization
get_current_state_value: get the current state value as a string for an entity using UUID7 ordering
timestamp_from_uuid: extract a datetime timestamp from a UUID7 ID for human-readable debugging
